name: io.github.lenmo181/novel-writing-skill
description: Mechanical validators and delivery gates for long-form Chinese web-novel authoring: chapter hard-checks (word count, format, dialogue ratio, AI-flavor index, text-wall), delivery-readiness gate, continuity/conflict scans, and skill self-diagnostics.

environmentVariables.name: NOVEL_SKILL_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to an externally installed skill package. Leave unset to use the full skill bundled inside the wheel.

environmentVariables.name: NOVEL_PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Default root directory for user novel projects (e.g. D:/novels).
